description: This file defines the ComputeTask class used for managing GPU compute operations in TensorFlow Lite's Metal delegate for GPU execution on Apple hardware. It includes declarations for initialization, parameter updates, encoding commands, resource management, and tuning, specifically tailored for Metal GPU programming.
external_methods: absl::Status Init(MetalDevice* device, const std::string& code, const std::map<std::string, std::string>& defines)
